dashboard.title: CVault
dashboard.subtitle: AI-powered CV parser
dashboard.description: CVault is a learning project designed to explore four AI engineering pillars through a concrete application. Drop a PDF CV — the pipeline extracts the text, builds a prompt, queries an LLM via Groq, and returns structured data in real time. The goal: understand how context engineering, orchestration pipelines, semantic search, and autonomous agents really work.
dashboard.phase1Desc: CV extraction and structuring with an LLM
dashboard.phase2Desc: Harness, document pipeline, and SQLite persistence
